As a Logistics Employee at GXO, working at the IKEA distribution center in Oosterhout, you will earn a starting salary of €17.27 gross per hour, with shift allowances increasing your hourly wage to up to €22.70.As a Logistics Employee, you are an essential part of the logistics process. You will work in Oosterhout, centrally located near Breda, Etten-Leur, Tilburg, Roosendaal and Dordrecht.Your responsibilities include packing, checking and preparing orders for shipment. You will use an EPT and handheld scanner to collect products, check their quality and make sure everything is packed safely and securely.You will work together with your team to ensure that orders are shipped on time. You will also keep your work area clean and help maintain a safe working environment.Every day is different. One day you may mainly be picking orders, while the next day you could be working at the packing station. As a Logistics Employee, you make sure customers receive their IKEA orders complete and on time. Thanks to your efforts, customers can quickly enjoy their favorite IKEA products at home.You will work in a three-shift system, meaning you may work early, late or night shifts. This provides plenty of variety and flexibility throughout your working week.The workplace is located in Oosterhout, with easy access from Breda, Etten-Leur, Tilburg, Roosendaal and Dordrecht.

Shift schedules:

- Night shift: Monday–Friday, 22:00–06:00
- Afternoon shift: Monday–Saturday, 14:00–22:00 (Saturday: 13:30–21:15)
- Morning shift: Monday–Saturday, 06:00–14:00 (Saturday: 06:00–13:30)

You are looking for a job as a Logistics Employee, Warehouse Employee, Order Picker, Warehouse Worker or Packer. You speak and understand English, as this is the main working language within the team. You are accurate, enjoy working as part of a team and keep your work area clean and organized. Experience with an EPT or handheld scanner is a plus, but not required.

Are you a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? Do you enjoy leading people, improving processes and delivering top-quality products? Then this role as Shift Leader Production at Venlo for you. 
What do we offer? - Competitive salary based on experience; - Travel allowance from your front door to ours; - Directly on contact for 1 year and after a permanent contract; - You work in a two-shift system; - Free access to the Gym and unlimited access to the online VR Academy; - Plenty of room for personal development; - A dynamic, growing organization with skilled colleagues; - Unlimited fresh herbs. 
What will you do? 
As Shift Leader Production, you are responsible for the daily operations of your shift (approx. 80 employees). Together with other Shift Leaders, you ensure safe, efficient and high-quality production. - Lead, coach and develop production teams; - Ensure production targets, planning and deadlines are met; - Monitor quality, safety and performance on the shop floor; - Lead daily whiteboard meetings; - Drive continuous improvement (Kaizen / 5S / Lean projects); - Coordinate with Technical Services, Logistics and Planning; - Report technical deviations and support problem-solving. 
What will you bring - Proven experience leading production teams (preferably in food production); - Strong leadership, decision-making and problem-solving skills; - Quality- and results-driven mindset; - Comfortable working cross-functionally; - English and Polish are required; Dutch is a plus.
